doc.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23

title: Everett Swan, Burns's valet
summary: Sonny Swan's real name was Everett; he drove for Burns and watched his money when Burns ran gambling clubs.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Yeah, he's a trumpet man. Yeah, I know. He played with everybody. Good one, too. Let's see now. Well... Oh, if you had more time around here, Jesus. I could write a book. Yeah. Can you remember Sonny Swan's real name? Everett.
Everett Swan? Everett Swan, sure. Oh, yeah. Everett Swan. Yeah.
Yeah. Yeah. What's that? Well, I was in, I had clubs, you know, gambling houses? Yeah. And he used to drive for me and he'd watch my money and all that kind of stuff.
